people.bio: Rubber-tapper turned prophet of Acre; founded the Santo Daime doctrine in the 1930s, weaving Christianity, shamanism and African spirit ways around the Daime sacrament.
people.name: Raimundo Irineu Serra (Mestre Irineu)

people.bio: Rubber-tapper of Rondônia; founded the União do Vegetal, teaching love of God and neighbour through the hoasca sacrament; doctrine affirmed by the US Supreme Court (2006).
people.name: José Gabriel da Costa (Mestre Gabriel)
